schema.text: When you don't feel safe in the evening, what do you usually do?

options.text: I still travel in the evening because I have to
I still go out, but I change my route, stop or company
I avoid travelling in the evening

en.#When you don't feel safe in the evening: When you don't feel safe in the evening, what do you usually do?
en.#I still travel in the evening because I: I still travel in the evening because I have to
en.#I still go out, but I change my route,: I still go out, but I change my route, stop or company
en.#I avoid travelling in the evening: I avoid travelling in the evening

it.#When you don't feel safe in the evening: Quando la sera non ti senti al sicuro, cosa fai di solito?
it.#I still travel in the evening because I: Mi sposto comunque la sera perché devo
it.#I still go out, but I change my route,: Esco lo stesso, ma cambio percorso, fermata o compagnia

fr.#When you don't feel safe in the evening: Quand vous ne vous sentez pas en sécurité le soir, que faites-vous habituellement ?
fr.#I still travel in the evening because I: Je me déplace quand même le soir parce que je dois le faire
fr.#I still go out, but I change my route,: Je sors quand même, mais je change d’itinéraire, d’arrêt ou de compagnie
fr.#I avoid travelling in the evening: J’évite de me déplacer le soir

de.#When you don't feel safe in the evening: Was tun Sie in der Regel, wenn Sie sich abends nicht sicher fühlen?
de.#I still travel in the evening because I: Ich bin trotzdem abends unterwegs, weil ich muss
de.#I still go out, but I change my route,: Ich gehe trotzdem aus dem Haus, ändere aber meine Route, Haltestelle oder Begleitung
de.#I avoid travelling in the evening: Ich vermeide es, abends unterwegs zu sein

tr.#When you don't feel safe in the evening: Akşamları kendinizi güvende hissetmediğinizde genellikle ne yaparsınız?
tr.#I still travel in the evening because I: Yine de akşamları yolculuk yapıyorum, çünkü mecburum
tr.#I still go out, but I change my route,: Yine de dışarı çıkıyorum, ama güzergâhımı, durağımı veya yanımdaki kişileri değiştiriyorum

fa.#When you don't feel safe in the evening: وقتی شب‌ها احساس امنیت نمی‌کنید، معمولاً چه کار می‌کنید؟
fa.#I still travel in the evening because I: با این حال شب‌ها رفت‌وآمد می‌کنم چون مجبورم
fa.#I still go out, but I change my route,: با این حال بیرون می‌روم، اما مسیر، ایستگاه یا همراهم را عوض می‌کنم
fa.#I avoid travelling in the evening: از رفت‌وآمد در شب پرهیز می‌کنم

hu.#When you don't feel safe in the evening: Mit szokott tenni, ha este nem érzi magát biztonságban?
hu.#I still go out, but I change my route,: Mégis útra kelek, de más útvonalat, megállót vagy társaságot választok

ar.#When you don't feel safe in the evening: عندما لا تشعر بالأمان في المساء، ماذا تفعل عادةً؟
ar.#I still travel in the evening because I: أتنقل مساءً رغم ذلك لأن الأمر ضروري
ar.#I still go out, but I change my route,: أخرج رغم ذلك، لكنني أغيّر طريقي أو محطتي أو من يرافقني
